evidence.title: DESIGN.md Style Extractor - TypeUI - Chrome Web Store

name: DESIGN.md Style Extractor - TypeUI
summary: Chrome extension that extracts a site's styles into DESIGN.md or SKILL.md files for AI coding agents.
description: A Chrome extension from Bergside SRL that reads styles from any website, detects CSS variables and writes DESIGN.md or SKILL.md files for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Google Stitch.
contains: detects CSS variables and builds a design profile
works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Google Stitch
